```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(alarmdata)
library(PL94171)
library(ggplot2)
library(redist)
library(ggredist)
library(sf)
options(scipen = 999)
```

### 2025 Texas Map

```{r}

# ALARM data map of Texas
map_texas <- alarm_50state_map("TX")

# PL 2020 data for Texas
pl_texas <- pl_read(pl_url("TX", year=2020))
# Block-level data with 15-digit GEOIDs that match PLANC2333
pl_texas_750 <- pl_subset(pl_texas, sumlev = "750")
# Derive the 11-digit GEOIDs from State + County + Voting District in PL
pl_texas_750$GEOID11 <- paste0(paste0(pl_texas_750$STATE, pl_texas_750$COUNTY), pl_texas_750$VTD)

# 2025 districts with associated 15-digit GEOIDs
texas_district_to_geoid <- readr::read_csv("PLANC2333/PLANC2333.csv")
texas_district_to_geoid <- texas_district_to_geoid |> mutate(SCTBKEY = as.character(SCTBKEY))

# Add the 2025 district #s by joining by 15-digit GEOIDs
pl_texas_750 <- left_join(pl_texas_750, texas_district_to_geoid, by = c("GEOID" = "SCTBKEY"))

# Make a new dataframe with just the derived 11-digit GEOIDs from PL and the 2025 district #s
texas_district_to_geoid11 <- pl_texas_750 |>
  select(GEOID11, DISTRICT) |>
  distinct(GEOID11, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Add the district #s onto the ALARM data, joining by the 11-digit GEOIDs
map_texas <- left_join(map_texas, texas_district_to_geoid11, by = c("GEOID" = "GEOID11"))

# 2025 district map with 2020 vote share data
map_texas |> 
    ggplot() +
    geom_district(aes(group = DISTRICT, fill = ndv, denom = nrv + ndv)) +
    scale_fill_party_c() +
    theme_map()

# Precincts colored by vote share with district borders overlaid
map_texas |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = ndv / (nrv + ndv)), color = NA) +
    geom_district(aes(group=DISTRICT), linewidth=0.6, fill = NA) +
    scale_fill_party_c() +
    theme_map()
```
